sourceVersion: Manuscript survey cohort and the November 18, 2026 behavioral data release (Prompt v3).
methodology: Respondents are counted once per dataset across the training and test splits. The totals combine the nine manuscript surveys with the three released behavioral datasets. Responses count individual respondent–question records. Counts are unweighted.
geographyNote: Counts retain each study’s geographic scope. Great Britain and the United Kingdom have separate survey-region entries. China (mainland) and Taiwan, China share map highlights and retain separate counts. Small regions can appear as points. Markers designate survey regions rather than individual locations.
versionNote: The nine manuscript surveys retain their original cohort of 281,995 dataset-level respondents and 8,725,666 records. The September 24, 2026 cleaned cohort excluded 18 respondents and their 18 records (ISSP2015: 3; ISSP2016: 4; ISSP2019: 9; ISSP2021: 2).
